as_told.title: Hancock on Rogan: Great Pyramid built under Khufu, subterranean part inherited

plain: A researcher and writer on ancient history, Graham Hancock, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, in 2022 that a rock-cut room about 100 feet straight down beneath the base of the Great Pyramid in Giza, Egypt, is, in his view, the original sacred site there, older in meaning than the pyramid above it. Another researcher, Luke Caverns, later passed the idea along on the same show, saying Hancock had told it on another podcast: most of the pyramid was built under the ancient king Khufu, and the underground level may have been there already. If true, it would mean the pyramid was built on top of an even older holy place.
